## Summary

Describe the outcome, motivation, and related requirement or issue.

## Changes

- List the focused changes included in this pull request.
- State important scope exclusions.

## Testing

List commands run and attach concise evidence. Explain any check that was not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the approved product and architecture documentation.
- [ ] The branch is current with its target branch and contains no unrelated changes.
- [ ] Commits and the pull request title follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Relevant lint, type, test, and build checks pass.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and important failure paths where applicable.
- [ ] Security, privacy, tenant isolation, and secrets handling were considered.
- [ ] API, migration, deployment, rollback, and compatibility impacts are documented or not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and ownership metadata are current.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated junk, or debug artifacts are included.
